excerpt: Parliament-Funkadelic guitarist and Rock-n-Roll Hall of Famer Michael Hampton is releasing a series of three albums, and Into the Public Domain is the first in that series.  Hampton came to prominence replacing Eddie Hazel in P-Funk making his debut with the band on 1975’s Let’s Take it to the Stage.
